text: 金十数据10月3日讯，中国互联网络信息中心政策与国际合作所日前在京发布《生成式人工智能应用发展报告（2026）》。报告显示，我国人工智能自主创新步伐加快，生成式人工智能对工业、农业、服务业、科研等领域的赋能效应进一步体现，各领域数智化水平持续提升。具身智能成为人工智能发展最活跃的方向之一，应用场景覆盖工业生产、医疗手术、生活服务等多个领域。据测算，2026年我国人形机器人全年整机产量有望突破10万台。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 3 - The Policy and International Cooperation Institute of the China Internet Network Information Center recently released the "Generative Artificial Intelligence Application Development Report (2026)" in Beijing. The report shows that China's pace of independent innovation in artificial intelligence is accelerating, the enabling effects of generative artificial intelligence on industry, agriculture, services, scientific research and other fields are further reflected, and the level of digital intelligence in various fields continues to improve. Embodied intelligence has become one of the most active directions in artificial intelligence development, with application scenarios covering industrial production, medical surgery, life services and many other fields. According to estimates, China's full-year humanoid robot complete machine output is expected to exceed 100,000 units in 2026.
